The Night Forge


Now and then a dwarven artisan crafting B-grade or better gear gets a rare result: a Foundation item, the work of Maphr's blessing. It is raw, and it needs a thorough varnishing.

Mammon's Varnish Enhancer - the Merchant of Mammon sells it, but you'd have to find him underground in the right season. I sell it here for the same 100,000 Adena. A Foundation item takes from 1 varnish to 16: weapons take the most.

Finish a Foundation item - bring the item and its varnish. A weapon comes back with its special ability. Armor and jewelry come back as masterwork pieces; the ones that were Foundation Sealed come back sealed, and need the unsealing below. Picked the wrong helmet? Bring it back and swap it for another kind, free of charge.

Unseal masterwork items - the seal comes off for the price the Blacksmith of Mammon asks: nothing for B-grade gloves and boots, Adena for A grade, Ancient Adena for S grade. Take the piece off first: I only see what's in your bag. Plain sealed items aren't my trade; the Master Blacksmith by the Arena does those, and everything else a smith does.
